|strategy=By Gregg Keefer, Gold 4<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/dagobah/light/small/dagobah.html</ref>

This is by far one of the best choices for a starting loccation you can use for the Light Side as it gives HUGE Force generation in a hurry! You'll activate 2 Force (plus 1 for yourself) on your first turn and there is a tradeoff as it gives the same amount to your opponent but the card text of this location allows you to make this up every turn if you put additional [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] sites in your deck. During your deploy phase you may dig out any [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] site from your Reserve Deck and deploy it! This saves you the trouble of waiting to draw up sites to get the Force flowing. I only put one such site in my deck and that is [[Yoda]]'s Hut (2 Force for me and zip for them), on my first turn I deploy it and BAM, on my second turn I am activating 5 Force.

All the [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] sites are good for you and do nothing for your opponent but too many of them will restrict your Force drain options so I usually only put in one or two to get the Force flowing and then move on to my real strategy. These sites will keep your opponent off balance, thinking you are playing a [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] drain or Jedi Training deck when you are really going to Cloud City or [[Tatooine]].

In addition to the Force generation, having these sites on the table lets you play Stone Piles and take 2 cards at random from your opponent's hand and place them in limbo on [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]]. There is nothing sweeter than a lucky pick removing the [[Executor]] or some other vital card from their strategy early in the game! So come back to [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]]. It's a slimy mudhole.

game! It sort of works like this: use [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]]'s "search" ability and deploy a [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] location every turn. This guarantees you Force every turn!
